summary.headline: KUKDO CHEMICAL amends filing: to acquire 30,000 shares (50% stake) in KUKDO INTERNATIONAL for KRW 50bn
summary.what_happened: KUKDO CHEMICAL CO.,LTD filed a corrected report on Nov 24, 2026 on its decision to acquire shares in KUKDO INTERNATIONAL CORP., a related company. The corrected filing sets the number of shares to be acquired at 30,000, bringing its post-acquisition holding to 128,000 shares, or a 50% stake, with the consideration paid in cash to fund a capital increase for a business transfer by the subsidiary. The filing states the KRW 50bn payment is expected in two installments: KRW 10bn in November 2026 (Nov 25, 2026) and KRW 40bn in the first half of 2027.
summary.why_it_matters: Corrected filings of this type typically update the share count, payment schedule or other terms of an investment that was previously disclosed, so investors can see the revised details. Acquisitions of stakes in related companies, especially when funded in cash, generally signal how the parent is deploying capital into its group companies.
